description: Finalize the reverse-engineered architecture and prepare for migration or development

actions.description: Resolve or document mitigation for gaps from RE-06
actions.llm_guidance:
For each gap in gap_analysis_report.json:
- Either fix the gap (add missing functions, resolve dependencies)
- Or document as known limitation with mitigation strategy

Update functional_architecture.json with fixes

Review:
- All functions present and categorized
- Dependencies consistent
- Clusters cohesive
- Entry points complete
- Service boundaries logical

Run: python3 {tools_path}/generate_human_documentation.py {system_root}/specs/functional/functional_architecture.json --output {system_root}/specs/human/documentation/

Or manually create FUNCTIONAL_ARCHITECTURE.md with:
- System overview
- Architecture diagram (Mermaid)
- Component descriptions
- Dependency map
- Key decisions

actions.description: Record completion and prepare for next workflow
actions.llm_guidance:
Update context/working_memory.json:
- Set current_step to 'RE-07-COMPLETE'
- Record artifacts created
- Note next workflow options:
  - 01f-language_migration (for migration projects)
  - 01b-bottom_up_integration (for modernization)
  - 02-artifacts_visualization (for documentation)

criteria: All critical gaps addressed or documented

completion_message: Reverse engineering workflow complete. The functional architecture has been extracted from the legacy codebase and is ready for the next phase.
